design.stratification: Joint 2D (language_group × era) cell targets. Region caps as hard secondary constraint. Country caps as hard limits. Franchise deduplication applied before sampling.
design.language_group_logic: Multi-language films: non-Anglophone country + English present → English dropped, first non-English token used. Chinese variants (Mandarin, Cantonese, etc.) → 'Chinese'. Silent / Experimental preserved as distinct groups.
